translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Kxaclve Angidr Sip
Rpi-mopwz Jiszs badr kx, “Naycmne-ebzpxbo dq ncblo kxaclve sip. Kxaclve Angidr sip dwatrpz mz naonrx. A' mrlx kx trdwatrpwzu mz naonrx, a' okilzbzle mz nibr bz, nide mrlx kxpna da.
Ncblo kc tqaclve naonrx, lvxpxbzle naonrx mz kxaclve sip. X sip nedeng nzkrlzlr natqde mz nzkqle-krbzle drtqdr, x sc tqvzmipxpeleng.
X nzvz-nqblqlr me vzkile, murde nzkrlzlr natqde.
Trnzvz-nqblqlru ncblo kzble, murde trnzkrlzlru natqde. A' nzdwaszlr nide.”
Yapwxtibz Jiszs badr nzycmne-ebzpxngr lc mz nzaelwapx-krde nzblepx-krde mz leplz kcng tzesabrtilr leplz. A' tryrplatitrpwzu nardr natqde.
Zbz sc tqrpipe-mopwz Jiszs kx, “Da angidrtx lc napibo bamu. Ninge naonrx kc tzdwakitr sip mz nzprtr-krbzlr badr kztedrng.
Leplz kcng tzvz-kaipqng mz ninge, nzalvztr-ngrdr da kx vz-rbr. X nzapulr kxnzpnang da x nzangqnguting. Delc sip trnzlalztq-ngrpwzlru badr.
X ninge naonrx kc tzvzkitr leplz mz nzkrlz-krbzlr Gct. Doa kx vztrp bange nide kx narlapx. X na-apule sip nenge mz nzdwatr-krmle x nzdwapx-krde mz nzrmcti-krde dakxnzng ngr nzlungr.
Vz-ngrmc murde sip nengeng namnc-zpwxng. A' ncblo kxpna da vztx-ngrple nzpnangr, nzrnibqngr x nzodangr.
“Da angidrtx lc napibo bamu. Ninge kz Kxaclve-angidrle sip. Murde Kxaclve-angidrle sip rlrpx-lzbqngr mz nzbz-krde mz nzarlapx-krde sip nedeng.
Ncblo kxnzawz, trnipleu ncblo kxaclve x rngine sip. Ncblo kxnzawz dwaszle sip mz nzmc-krde nzvz-krm kuli kzpeto. Zbz kuli kc sc tqlolvzpele kcng x aodalitipele kcng.
Ncblo kxnzawz dwa murde yc txpwz mz drtwrde nzatatr-ngrm trau, a' tryc-ngru drtwrde sip.
Ninge Kxaclve Angidr sip. Krlzx sip nengeng x nzkrlzlr ninge, da kc tqwai nzkrlzkr Trtenge ninge x nzkrlz-krnge Trtenge. X rlrpx-lzbq-ngrne mz nzbz-krnge nidr.

Kzdung sip kx nangi nengeng trnzprtrkang mz nabxbz nyznge. Krlcdeng navzmi-kzpc'ng mz nabxbz nyznge x sa naxlr-kzplr natqnge. Murde sip nengeng amrlx nanginidr dzbede kx esz', x nangininge txpwz kxaclvele nidr.
“X rlrpx-ngrne nznibq-krdr ninge murde krlzx kx sa nalu-mopwc'. Delc Trtenge tqmrlzti-zlwz-ngrde ninge.
Trpnzngr kx nanibqle ninge, a' ninge kx narlr-lzbq-ngrbz mz nznibq-krdr ninge. Murde rngiscnge zmatq ngr nzka-krbo nzlungr x nzrkatx-krngele. Krlc natq kx kam Trtenge bange kx na-angidax.”
Zbz lr Jiu sc tzaki-lzbqpe-moung mz natq kcng tqpiti Jiszs.
Leplz nzkqlung nzrpilr kx, “Eke! Mrlx lc dwasz drka', delc tqlukurnr-ngrde. ?Memule tqlalztq-ngrbzmu bade?”
A' kzdu-kzng nzrpilr kx, “Ncblo kx dwasz drka' nzycmne-krde trkxmuleu lc. ?Myx kxmule, drka' krlzle nzaobqpx-krde mz kxmwi?”
Kxnzetu R Lr Jiu Nzpxtxpx-mou-ngrdr Jiszs

Mzli lcpwz, mzli r zbao mz Disembz, ycpe pipz nzkaputr-krm Nzyrlwr-lxblrngr mz Nzatr-moungr Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe Jerusalem. X nigr badr Jiszs sc tqvztrpekr Mangr-nzangiongr, x sc tqvznepe mz Makoa nyz Solomon.

Kxnzetu r lr Jiu nzvzmqng nzmnc-ngalelvzlr nide, murde nzrpilr namctrpzlr dq da kx vz-rbrtile. X sc tzrpipebzlr kx, “Mzli boipe, a' drtwrgr kc tqveabe. Kx nim Kxnzmcpx o trtingr, pi-zpwxm bagr murde nakrlzkr.”
Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Pipebo bamu, a' trlxngitiwamuu ninge. Rkx kcng tqalexng mz zmatq ngr Trtenge, da lcng nzaelwapx-ngrbzlr bamu ncblo kc tqngininge.
A' trlxngitiwamuu murde trnipwamuu sip nengeng.
X krlzx sip nengeng, nzxlrmlr natqnge, x nzvz-nqblqmlr ninge.
Kabo badr nzlungr kxboi x trtxpnzngr nzbz-krdr. X trtxpnzngr kx narvecpxm mz mqnge.
Trtenge kc tqrkam bange myapxbz mz leplz amrlx. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, trtxpnzngr kx navecpxmle nidr mz mq Trtenge.
Da zpwxtx, nigr ncdr Trtenge da kxesz'.”
Kx nzxlrbzlr natqde lcng, drtwrdr kc tqngyape mou. Murde rtulrtr-lzbqbz mz nzrsakrlr-krdr ncdr Gct. X sc tzrtrngzope mou rplz kx nzvaebq-ngrdele.
A' rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Da kxkqlu kx alepex mz zmatq ngr Trtenge mz nzokatr-krnge leplz. ?A' myx mz da lcng kx takitrde nzvaebq-krmu ninge?”
Nzrpibzlr bade kx, “Trnavaebq-ngrgru nim nzale-krm da kxmrlz, a' mz nzamatine-krm Gct. Murde nim ncblo txne, a' rtulrtr-lzbqm mz nzrpi-krm kx nim Gct.”
Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Nzyro mz Nzryrngrkxtr kx rpibz Gct badr kzdung leplz kx nzapulr nide.
Krlzku kx nike pi Nzryrngrkxtr ngi zvz da zpwx. Delc Gct tramatine-lzbqu mz nzrpi-krde kx leplz lcng nzapu-kzlr nide.
?Mz nzmu-krde lcde, myx kxmu nzamatine-krnge Gct mz nzrpi-krnge ninge mrlxde? Murde mcpx Trtenge ninge, x atwzlr-ngrmle ninge mz nrlc.

Rtrngzti-zpwxbo me pnz drtwrde. Nzmu trna-alewxu da lcng, sa tqmrlz trnzlxngiti-krpwamuu ninge. Kxmule-esz' trlxngitiwamuu nzrpi-krbo ninge Mrlx Gct, a' narlxngitiamu murde vz-nqblqx natqdeng. X mz nzvz-nqblq-krnge natqdeng, nakrlz-angidramu kx Trtenge sc tqmncm bange x sc tqmncbo bade.”
Kx nzxlrbzlr nzycmnekr Jiszs drtwrdr kc tqngyatxpe mou. X sc tzrpilr nalolvzpe-ngrdr nide. A' ani txpwz nzrlasz-krde Mangr-nzangiongr.
Nigr badr Jiszs rkalzmgr Judiz Provins x kawickr LueJodzn. Vzkr mrkc tqawrkxtr-pnzngr Jon, x sc tqmncpekr elr.

Leplz nzkqlung nzvzmqng elr mz nzxlr-krbzlr nzycmne-krde. Zbz sc tzrpipelr kx, “Ncblo lc opxm nide Kxnzmcpx, murde aelwapxngr rkx kxkqlu. Kxmule-esz' Jon Kxawrkxtr trpnzngr rkx kx aelwapx-ngrde, a' Jiszs angidatipele da amrlx kcng tqyapwxtingr Jon nide.”
X leplz nzkqlung nzlxngitilr kx nide Kxnzmcpx.

footnotes.text: Jiszs nide Kxaclve Angidr Sip, x ni-kzde Kxaclve sip kxmyapxbz [Hibru 13:20-21] x Kxetu r kxnzaclvelr sip nedeng. [1 Pita 5:4]

-23 Mz nzyrlwr-lxblrngr mz Nzatr-moungr Mangr-nzangiongr nadcpxngr mz drtwrdr nzalqngr x nzrlvxpxngr mou Mangr-nzangiongr mz nibr nzatrkatikr kzdq kxetu r ncblo ngr vea kxtrngiulrJiu. Mc Daniel 11:31. Zbq lcng nzrpi-kzpzlr Nzyrlwr-lxblrngr Kxyzlr.
